reviews.title: Worst Experience
reviews.text: I had an incredibly disappointing experience with Royal Air Maroc at Washington Dulles airport. My husband, child, and I needed assistance, but the airline staff failed to provide any meaningful help. Initially, they claimed we didn't have tickets, but later found our reservation. However, they couldn't locate my husband's ticket and instructed us to contact customer service. I promptly called customer service, and they assured me that my ticket had been processed and I had 15 minutes to check in at the counter. Despite being at the ticket counter and explaining my situation, the staff didn't listen to me, closed up, and left. As someone who is legally blind, I found their behavior to be incredibly rude and insensitive. To add insult to injury, when I contacted Royal Air Maroc for a refund, they unjustly claimed it was a no-show situation. They directed me to fill out a complaint and refund form, which I promptly did on June 9. However, despite my numerous attempts to call them from June 9 until June 23, I have received no response whatsoever. This entire experience has been the worst I have ever encountered. The lack of assistance, the dismissive attitude, and the subsequent lack of response regarding my refund have left me deeply disappointed with Royal Air Maroc.

reviews.title: Worst Airline Ever
reviews.text: My mom and I used this airline to get to and from Spain. On our way home they lost our luggage. Luckily we have air tags and know that they are at the airport in Casablanca. We landed at home in the US and there was not a single Royal air maroc employee in the airport in order to make our claim (we looked everywhere we could). We used the website to try to make a claim but we needed our claim number. We tried calling for 4 hours to get a claim number. Every person said we must return to the airport when there was a departing flight. So we drove the 4 hours to the airport. Asked the ticketing people and we’re told to wait for a specific person. They called him a few time and he never showed. Over 2.5 hours of waiting.. nothing. They closed the counter and left l, said he’d be right there. 30 more minutes… still no one. We left. Tried calling again to explain the situation. “We can’t do that over the phone, you have to go to the airport” is what we keep hearing. How the hell do we get our luggage back!!!!

Then, our flight home was further delayed by an additional five hours which Connors back to Miami at 2 o’clock in the morning! Our luggage was not at baggage claim. Airport security told us to talk to the Royal air. Maroc representative, who was supposed to be at the carousel, but there was no one to be found. So, we tried going to the ticket area to find anybody from Royal air Maroc, but at 2 o’clock in the morning there was, no one. As of this writing, I have put in a ticket for our luggage and also to see if they would compensate us for the extended delay. It is very difficult to figure out how and whom to contact anyone and finally had to try doing a form, which said would give me an automatic reply to my email when it was complete. That was an hour and a half ago and I have no automatic response and no way of knowing if they’ve received my ticket or how to follow up on it. There website says to arrive three hours early for an international flight and another place on the confirmation, said four hours early, but no one shows up until two hours early for any of them. reviews.title: DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY AND TIME
reviews.text: - the toilets are often in a disgusting state when you arrive in the aircraft (they don’t clean between flights, leaving all the dirty from the flight before, nothing I have ever seen on other flights, and I have flown hundreds and hundreds of times). - flight attendant opened the bathroom while it was locked before take-off, and without even knocking! - the food options are not great, especially non-meat options. - some airplanes are very worn out: my seat had NO SEATBELT, it was on the floor, and I was terrified to seat there and the belt would break again so I requested to change seat because I didn’t want to travel with a broken seatbelt and they did a quick fix (which I'm pretty sure in case of emergency the belt would not hold me on my seat) and they told me that it was not possible to switch seats. Also, some armchairs were falling off. - no entertainment options or charging outlets on planes. - no warning of certain scheduled routes (e.g., the Guinea-Bissau stop in the Casablanca-Praia route).

reviews.title: The Worst Travel Experience Ever!
reviews.text: I recently flew round trip from JFK to BCN with a layover in Casablanca each way with Royal Air Maroc and can confidently say that unless I am left with no other choice, I will NOT be flying this airline again. It all started a few days before the first flight when my family and I noticed that there was a typo in my name; after spending 4+ hours on the phone, most of which I was on hold or trying to reach someone to speak to, the only option they presented me with was that I had to cancel my ticket and purchase another round trip ticket for over $2,000 USD - a markup of over 100% than my original ticket! They would not apply any credit from my original booking to the new one they forced me to buy or even attempt to confirm my identity through my passport, drivers license, or birth certificate. The customer service representatives on the phone were not helpful, loud, rude, and dismissive. On top of all this, both the first and connecting flight had open seats around the plane and I was obviously lied to that the flights were “fully booked” and that in order to travel I needed to purchase a new ticket. I have proof of the empty seats on both flights. Next, in Casablanca I attempted to be switched to the flight that the rest of my family was on as I knew that seats were still available and the representative at the desk did not even bother to stand up from her chair behind the high counter and continued her conversation in her AirPod while telling me that there was nothing possi

reviews.title: Incredible country, worst airline
reviews.text: It is such a shame that this airline is so freaking terrible. This is my first trip to Morroco, and I absolutely recommend coming to this beautiful country. I travel all around the world for business, and have never come across an airline that cares less about the quality of service. When arriving at the airport, we got in line to get our tickets. The very unpleasant employees for the airline proceeded to tell me I needed a visa to travel back to Spain. He went to talk to management and found out he was completely wrong. I proceeded to ask him for an upgraded seat in which he ignored me and didn't help after asking many times. Fast forward to boarding the plane, there was an very long wait board time. Entering the plane, there were so many open seats and plenty in first class. There is no air conditioning, and it was probably 95 degrees in the plane while we were waiting to take off with absolutely no air ventilation. Very uncomfortable and honestly miserable. Again, I met so many beautiful and friendly people in Morroco. And I so highly recommend you visit here if you love a vast and interesting history, beautiful architecture, and rich culture. It is such a shame that this airline leaves such a sour taste in my mouth. I will definitely be coming back to Morroco because I am in love with it, but I will make sure all my friends and family will never use this terrible airline. If I could give a negative star rating I definitely would. Wishing anyone that reads this an amazing

reviews.text: We flew from Miami to Casablanca. Somehow our luggage were not sent. We waited 2 hours then r Filed a report to be sent to out next destination, Fez. We were there for 2 days. It took them 4 days to send them there, by that time we were in the Sahara and heading back to Casablanca. I called them before they sent them to Fez and asked simply to keep them in Casablanca but they didn’t do it, even though they keep assuring they will. Then never sent them back to Casablanca. We spend our vacation without our luggage and going back to US without them. Poor communication and lack of professionalism are the two features of this airline.

reviews.title: Did not have to be the worst
reviews.text: Lack of communication. Impacted by the airport strikes across Europe and this review does not hold the airline responsible for what caused the delay, this review does address their response and customer service. Flight from BCN to CMN became delayed due to strikes and the airline never provided updates to what was causing the delay until pressed and relied on the phrase "I don't know" as the standard response. Their lack of effort to provide updates created massed confusion and anxiety amongst the passengers. The flight attendant walked off and never returned, airport personnel eventually arrived, and the flight took off 3 hours delayed. This delay in leaving resulted in half the passengers missing their connecting flights to IAD, JFK and MIA. Upon arrival at CMN we were not met by any RAM personnel and after 20 minutes a young lady arrived and was confused by what we were asking. She also got up and left without providing answers. When RAM personnel equipped to handle the situation arrived new boarding passes were issued and incorrect guidance was passed that almost resulted in being arrested for illegal entry into the country. This mistake was clearly avoidable and demonstrates a lack of customer service which previous reviews indicate as a problem. From my own experience this is a cultural problem. The airline did provide a hotel for an overnight stay. This hotel did not have any towels and advised to use the sheets on the bed as a towel. Cultural food was provided however

reviews.title: Poor service, disorganized, but got us there safely
reviews.text: Our outbound flight from JFK was mostly as-planned with one exception. I’d called ahead to confirm they could accommodate dietary restrictions (I’m Celiac). Following the correct process, I could see on my itinerary that I’d requested a gluten-free meal. On-board at dinner time, I mentioned this to the attendant, who responded with ‘we have no idea what you’re talking about….pasta, chicken or fish?’. Fast forward 7 hours wherein I ate only yogurt. It was good yogurt, but I hadn’t grabbed other food because so many meals were planned for this flight. On the return, we got a message that the flight was delayed 2 hours. We later got an e-mail it was back on-track; all immaterial because we’re seasoned travelers and know that a delay doesn’t assure you time to luxuriate at the hotel. Prior to take-off, the projections suggested connections were still within reach, but immediately prior to take-off (on taxi), the pilot projected a landing time well beyond our connection, but it was too late to call and make changes. Boarding: They re-examined our luggage for contraband: liquids and powders. All water purchased in the terminal was confiscated. Boarding in A, B, C or D (maybe E) groups effectively just got you to busses taking us to the plane on the tarmac. The 2 rolling stairs were divided between 1st/Business Class, and everyone else. People who were WAY behind us ended up in front of us. It was inefficient and chaotic. We took off more than 3 hours late. Despite confiscating our

reviews.text: This airline is so bad even when the Moroccans tell you not to fly on it. My return flight was two hours late so I missed my connection. I arrived at at 1 AM, and they gave me a voucher for a room and breakfast and supper at the hotel and also I was to receive transportation to and from the hotel. They then booked me for a flight where I had to be back at the airport at 4:30 AM only 3 1/2 hours after arrival. When I got to the hotel, I was informed that breakfast started at 5 o’clock so I would not be able to get breakfast. I know Shuttle did not start until 5 AM so I could not get the shuttle, the flight attendants were extremely rude and made no attempt to assist customers. I wanted to upgrade the business class, but they said because my connecting flight with was JetBlue they couldn’t upgrade me. Hard to believe they didn’t want my money. This is a terrible airline always late pay the extra money and go with some other airline . My seat for the seven hour flight was broken the whole way so every time I tried to push the seat back and sleep it threw me forward the flight attendant receipts a switched me to open seat.
